spans.s:
r. 4th cl. (रुप्यति)
To confound, to perplex, to confuse.

r. 10th cl. (रूपयति)
To form, to express form, to represent shape either to the eye or the understanding.
With नि prefixed,
1 To discuss, to investigate.
2 To explain, to describe, to declare, to expound.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Like, resembling, (in composition, as पितृरूपः पुत्त्रः a son like his father.)
n. (-पं)
1 Natural property or disposition nature.
2

Beauty.
3

Form, figure.
4 Appearance, semblance.
5 Cattle generally, flocks and herds, &c.
6 A verse.
7 Declension, conjugation, the inflection of nouns or verbs.
8 A play, a dramatic poem.
9 Acquiring familiarity with any book or authority by frequent perusal, learning by heart or rote.
10 An image, a figure, a reflection or resemblance of any real object.
11 Colour, form, any object of vision.
12 (In arithmetic,) Discrete or distinct quantity, an entire number.
13 Known quantity, whence the first syllable Rū is used in algebra to express the same.
E.
रूप to express form, aff. क, or रु to sound, Uṇādi aff. प, and the radical vowel made long.

n. (-कं)
1 A drama, a dramatic poem.
2 Shape, form, figure.
3 A figure of rhetoric in general.
4 A particular class of rhetorical or poetical figures, including various modes of poetical description, or the illustration and exhibition of visible things and persons.
5 Identification of the objects of a comparison; their being not only like, but the very same.
6 Symptom of disease.
f. (-पिका)
Swallow wort.
E.
रूप form, figure, aff. कन्.

n. (-त्त्वं)
Natural or inherent disposition or property, nature.
E.
रूप form, and तत्त्व truth, essence.

mfn. (-धृत्)
Having the form, resembling, like.
E.
रूप, and धृ to have, क्विप् aff., and तुक् added.

m. (-नः)
An owl.
E.
रूप form, and नाशन destroying.

mfn. (-भृत्)
Having form or beauty.
E.
रूप, and भृ to possess, aff. क्विप्, and तुक् added.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Describing, representing.
E.
रूप to form, शतृ aff.

n. (-ण्यं)
Elegance, loveliness.
E.
रूप, and लावण्य beauty.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Having shape or colour, &c.
2 Well-shaped, beautiful, handsome.
E.
रूप form, &c., and मतुप् poss. aff.

f. (-त् or -ट्)
Beauty.
E.
रूप, and सम्पट् fortune.

f. (-वा)
A whore, a harlot.
E.
रूप beauty, and आजीव who lives by.

m. (-धः)
The perception, evidence, or influence of the senses, i. e. of colour, sound, odour, flavour, and contact.
E.
रूप, and अधिबोध perception.

m. (-स्त्रः)
KĀMADEVA.
E.
रूप beauty, and अस्त्र a weapon.

mfn. (-पी-पिणी-पि)
1 Beautiful, having a handsome form or shape.
2 Having form or shape.
E.
रूप, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
Handsome, beautiful.
n. (-प्यं)
1

Silver.
2

Wrought silver.
3 Wrought gold.
E.
रूप form, colour, &c., and यत् aff.

m. (-क्षः)
The master of the mint, the superintendant of the silver, or silver coinage.
E.
रूप्य silver, and अध्यक्ष superintendant.
